h:
Package maps defines various functions useful with maps of any type.

This package does not have any special handling for non-reflexive keys (keys k where k != k), such as floating-point NaNs.

All.s: func maps.All[Map ~map[K]V, K comparable, V any](m Map) iter.Seq2[K, V]
All.h: All returns an iterator over key-value pairs from m. The iteration order is not specified and is not guaranteed to be the same from one call to the next.

Clone.s: func maps.Clone[M ~map[K]V, K comparable, V any](m M) M
Clone.h: Clone returns a copy of m. This is a shallow clone: the new keys and values are set using ordinary assignment.

Collect.s: func maps.Collect[K comparable, V any](seq iter.Seq2[K, V]) map[K]V
Collect.h: Collect collects key-value pairs from seq into a new map and returns it.

Copy.s: func maps.Copy[M1 ~map[K]V, M2 ~map[K]V, K comparable, V any](dst M1, src M2)
Copy.h: Copy copies all key/value pairs in src adding them to dst. When a key in src is already present in dst, the value in dst will be overwritten by the value associated with the key in src.

DeleteFunc.s: func maps.DeleteFunc[M ~map[K]V, K comparable, V any](m M, del func(K, V) bool)
DeleteFunc.h: DeleteFunc deletes any key/value pairs from m for which del returns true.

Equal.s: func maps.Equal[M1, M2 ~map[K]V, K, V comparable](m1 M1, m2 M2) bool
Equal.h: Equal reports whether two maps contain the same key/value pairs. Values are compared using ==.

EqualFunc.s: func maps.EqualFunc[M1 ~map[K]V1, M2 ~map[K]V2, K comparable, V1, V2 any](m1 M1, m2 M2, eq func(V1, V2) bool) bool
EqualFunc.h: EqualFunc is like Equal, but compares values using eq. Keys are still compared with ==.

Insert.s: func maps.Insert[Map ~map[K]V, K comparable, V any](m Map, seq iter.Seq2[K, V])
Insert.h: Insert adds the key-value pairs from seq to m. If a key in seq already exists in m, its value will be overwritten.

Keys.s: func maps.Keys[Map ~map[K]V, K comparable, V any](m Map) iter.Seq[K]
Keys.h: Keys returns an iterator over keys in m. The iteration order is not specified and is not guaranteed to be the same from one call to the next.

Values.s: func maps.Values[Map ~map[K]V, K comparable, V any](m Map) iter.Seq[V]
Values.h: Values returns an iterator over values in m. The iteration order is not specified and is not guaranteed to be the same from one call to the next.
